title: Coherent geometric Mayer–Vietoris triangle cocone before applying Hom
statement: Let I be a directed preorder and R:I→CommRing a diagram with colimit cocone c and witness hc. Fix i∈I, a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], and a locally finitely presented qcqs map s₀:X→Spec(R_i). Suppose the fixed-universe derived category D(O_Z) [def-pc-derived-category] exists for every scheme Z. Let U,V be opens of X, U compact and V affine. Let t:Y→X be an open immersion with range U∪V, and s:Y→Spec(R_i) equal to t≫s₀, locally finitely presented and qcqs. Suppose the localized module-site derived categories on every open of Y exist. Let P,Q be perfect objects [def-pc-perfect-complex] of D(O_Y). There exist a tail-indexed functor D of distinguished triangles in the fixed category D(O_Y), a cocone d with distinguished apex, stage equivalences e_j from ULift Hom(P,(D_j)₁[0]) to Hom(P_j,Q_j), and a limit equivalence b of the analogous Hom groups. Postcomposition by the zero-shift first component of a transition is identified by e with perfectStageMap; postcomposition by the zero-shift first component of a cocone leg is identified with perfectLimitMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. Apply the actual canonical five-term Hom row functor [lem-pc-perfect-hom-triangle-row-presentations] to this cocone. For its four noncentral columns, the induced group-colimit comparison has PerfectHomLocalMap(R,c,i,X,s₀,U,V,-) [def-pc-perfect-hom-local-map]. This statement supplies triangle data and geometric comparison equations, but no group-row complex or short-complex presentation witnesses.

proof.text: Since s and s₀ are qcqs over affine schemes, Y is compact and quasi-separated and X is quasi-separated. The open immersion t is quasi-compact. Its preimages of U,V are compact and cover Y by the range equation.
Construct the quasi-coherent representing cocone F,d₀ with its universally natural Hom equivalences and pinned transition/cocone equations.

Apply schemeDerived_mayerVietoris_naturality on the preimage cover. Package the units, boundary, distinguishedness and prescribed component equations into a natural family A. The proved A.diagram and A.cocone constructions give D,d and all functor/cocone laws; distinguishedness follows objectwise.

Compose the representing equivalences with ULift and the zero-shift isomorphism. Naturality of shiftFunctorZero and the representing pinning equations give exactly perfectStageMap and perfectLimitMap.
Apply local outer-column recognition to this actual geometric family and representing cocone. Its hypotheses specify the outer objects and maps; no assertion about arbitrary triangle cocones is used.

lean.statement: theorem perfect_hom_mayerVietoris_triangle_cocone {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀] [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t] (ht : t.opensRange = U ⊔ V) (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s] [∀ W : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))] (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q) : ∃ (D : Set.Ici i ⥤ Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Y)) (d : Cocone D), (∀ j, D.obj j ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Y)) ∧ d.pt ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ∧ ∃ (e : ∀ j : Set.Ici i, ULift.{u} (P ⟶ (D.obj j).obj₁⟦(0 : ℤ)⟧) ≃ ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj P ⟶ (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q)) (b : ULift.{u} (P ⟶ d.pt.obj₁⟦(0 : ℤ)⟧) ≃ ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶ (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q)), (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i) (hjk : j ≤ k) (f : ULift.{u} (P ⟶ (D.obj j).obj₁⟦(0 : ℤ)⟧)), e k ⟨f.down ≫ (D.map (homOfLE hjk)).hom₁⟦(0 : ℤ)⟧'⟩ = perfectStageMap R s j.property hjk (e j f)) ∧ (∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (f : ULift.{u} (P ⟶ (D.obj j).obj₁⟦(0 : ℤ)⟧)), b ⟨f.down ≫ (d.ι.app j).hom₁⟦(0 : ℤ)⟧'⟩ = perfectLimitMap R c s j.property (e j f)) ∧ ∀ (r : Fin 5), r.val ≠ 2 → PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V (colimit.desc ((D ⋙ perfectHomTriangleRowFunctor Y P).flip.obj r) ⟨(perfectHomTriangleRow Y P d.pt).obj r, (perfectHomTriangleRowCoconeMap Y P D d).app r⟩)
